why.title: Plenty of suppliers can sell you vanilla.
why.subtitle: Few can send you the same quality twice.
why.intro: We built La Vanilla Supplier for buyers who are tired of surprises: beans drier than the sample, missing paperwork, or a supplier who goes quiet after payment. Here is what we do differently.

points.title: Straight from Java's growers
points.body: We work hand in hand with smallholder farmers and the curing houses that prepare their beans, with no traders in between. Fewer hands means fresher beans and honest prices.

points.title: Approve a sample first
points.body: Start with a free sample (you only cover shipping). Once you approve it, your order is graded and packed to match, so what you tested is what arrives.

points.title: Paperwork done right
points.body: Phytosanitary certificate, commercial invoice, packing list and air waybill with every shipment, plus a Certificate of Analysis for each batch on request.

points.title: Private label, under your brand
points.body: Launch your own vanilla line without building a supply chain. We pack beans, paste and powder under your label, ready for your shelves or your customers.

points.title: Fast air freight worldwide
points.body: Shipped to 20+ countries in 3–7 days on FCA, CPT or DDP terms, from 1 kg up to regular production volumes.
